knowledgeArticles.title: How to Connect to Corporate GlobalProtect / WireGuard VPN
knowledgeArticles.content:
### Overview
All remote employees must connect via the corporate VPN gateway before accessing internal Git repositories, ERP databases, or staging clusters.

### Step 1: Install the Client
1. Visit `https://vpn.lakhanglobal.com` and sign in with your corporate SSO credentials.
2. Download the client installer for Windows (MSI) or macOS (PKG).
3. Follow the on-screen prompts. Note that macOS requires allowing system extension under **Settings > Privacy & Security**.

### Step 2: Portal Address Configuration
- **Primary Portal URL**: `vpn-us.lakhanglobal.com`
- **EMEA Gateway**: `vpn-uk.lakhanglobal.com`
- **Auth Method**: Corporate Okta Single Sign-On + Microsoft Authenticator Push notification.

### Troubleshooting
- If handshakes fail, verify you are not on hotel/airplane Wi-Fi blocking UDP port 443 / 500.
- Switch to TCP Fallback mode in the app Preferences if strict firewalls drop UDP packets.

knowledgeArticles.title: Self-Service Password Reset (SSPR) & Multi-Factor Auth Setup
knowledgeArticles.content:
### Resetting Your Account Password
If your corporate password has expired or is locked out:
1. Navigate to `https://auth.lakhanglobal.com/reset`.
2. Enter your primary email address.
3. Authenticate using your Microsoft Authenticator biometric prompt or registered hardware FIDO2 key.
4. Select a new password meeting policy: minimum 16 characters, uppercase, lowercase, numbers, and no previous 10 passwords reused.

### Adding a Backup MFA Device
Always register a secondary phone number or security key to prevent lockouts during international travel.

knowledgeArticles.title: Outlook 365 Indexing and Search Troubleshooting Guide
knowledgeArticles.content:
### Symptom
Search in Microsoft Outlook returns "We are having trouble fetching results" or CPU spikes to 100%.

### Resolution Steps
1. Open Windows **Control Panel > Indexing Options**.
2. Click **Advanced**, then select **Rebuild Index**.
3. In Outlook, navigate to **File > Account Settings > Data Files**, select your mailbox and click **Settings > Advanced**, ensuring "Use Cached Exchange Mode" is checked for 1 Year.
4. Restart your workstation.

knowledgeArticles.title: Connecting to Corporate High-Speed Wi-Fi (802.1X EAP-TLS)
knowledgeArticles.content:
### SSID: `Lakhan-Corporate-Secure`
- **Security Type**: WPA3-Enterprise (802.1X)
- **EAP Method**: PEAP / MSCHAPv2 or EAP-TLS using your MDM machine certificate.
- **Identity**: `username@lakhanglobal.com`
- **Certificate Trust**: Verify root CA is `Lakhan Global Internal Root CA G3`.
